newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wolford shareholders approve bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Wolford shareholders approve bonus issue.

text.p: Austrian hosiery and lingery maker Wolford AG said on Tuesday its shareholders had approved a one-for-one bonus issue to double the firm's base capital to 500 million schillings.
The new shares will be listed on October 7, chief financial officer Karl Michael Millauer told Reuters.

The Vorarlberg-based company's shares have surged 60 percent since the start of the year and 480 percent since Wolford went public on Valentine's Day last year, making them the Vienna bourse's best performer.
